checks.name: Compiled preview is available with a read-only server
Welcome presents Start before mounting an application workspace
Start opens the own-project upload workspace
The guided live trial remains accessible
The custom task appears in the actual sample DOM during execution
Original buggy app produces two passes and one real persistence failure
Exported task exactly matches the observed sample DOM
Run identity and timestamps are created by this visit
Report describes its real in-browser runner and DOM-render evidence
Each criterion includes a non-empty PNG rendered from the inspected DOM
All four planned capture points preserve actual DOM render images
Creation and post-reload captures differ with the observed app state
The actual sample reloads its first session and validates blanks in a separate session
Persistence assertion reports the exact missing task, not a canned diagnosis
Blank-name acceptance inspects both empty and whitespace submissions
Finishing a trial removes its own sample keys and preserves unrelated storage
Repair brief contains this run, failed requirement, exact task, and honest execution scope
Prepared fixed version genuinely passes all three original criteria
Prepared fix uses the same plan with a new run, task, and timestamp
The original failing baseline stays unchanged beside its follow-up
Prepared fixed trial also removes only its own storage
Starting another prepared rerun clears the previous verified banner and comparison
Cancelling that rerun cannot inherit its earlier verified result
A cancelled prepared rerun still preserves the exact original baseline
Cancel keeps an incomplete run instead of declaring unchecked criteria passed
Cancelling preserves unrelated storage and removes the cancelled session
Retry executes fresh checks after cancellation
Live trial and result remain within a 390px viewport
Concurrent tabs retain independent run IDs and task names
Concurrent tabs each inspect their own board and complete the same real outcomes
Concurrent trial cleanup leaves no cross-tab sample data
Disabling actual submission changes the result: creation fails and dependent reload remains unchecked
The altered application cannot reuse the normal predetermined outcome
Leaving #trial removes its iframe and stops further fixture execution
Leaving the route aborts and cleans only its own trial session
Live execution makes no server mutations or model API requests
The existing recorded Evidence Studio remains available at #studio
Product language remains English
No requests leave the local compiled preview
No broken product or sample resources
No uncaught browser exceptions across live, cancellation, and recorded flows
